chemical.name: Azoxystrobin 250 g/L SC (Amistar)
chemical.dosage: 15 mL per 16 L knapsack sprayer (100 mL/acre)
chemical.instructions: Spray during calm weather, thoroughly covering the plant foliage. Use clean water.

chemical.name: Tebuconazole 250 g/L EC (Folicur)
chemical.instructions: Alternate with non-triazole fungicides to prevent resistance development.

organic.name: Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%)
organic.dosage: 50 g crushed neem seed per liter of water (800 g / 16 L sprayer)
organic.instructions: Extract overnight in water, filter through muslin cloth, and spray early in the morning.

organic.name: Trichoderma viride Bio-fungicide formulation
organic.dosage: 5 g/kg seed treatment or 2.5 kg/ha mixed with well-rotted organic compost
organic.instructions: Apply at the root zone during moist soil conditions to establish beneficial fungal colony.

cultural.description: Drain stagnant water for 48 hours to aerate the root zone and reduce humidity within the crop canopy.
Apply supplemental MOP (Muriate of Potash) at 15 kg/acre to reinforce cell walls against fungal penetration. Avoid excessive nitrogen.
Remove weed hosts (e.g., Echinochloa colona, Leersia hexandra) along field bunds that harbor fungal spores.

prevention: Use certified clean seed paddy sourced from DOA seed production farms (e.g., Bg 352, Bg 358, Bw 367).
Perform hot water seed treatment at 52°C–54°C for 15 minutes before pre-germination.
Maintain balanced N:P:K fertilization as per DOA agro-ecological zone guidelines.
Adopt optimal planting density (20 cm x 15 cm) to promote air circulation within the canopy.
source: Sri Lanka Department of Agriculture (DOA) - Field Handbook on Paddy Pathology & Disease Management (2023 Edition)
symptoms_confirmed: Oval brown lesions on leaf blades with grey/whitish centers
Yellow chlorotic halo surrounding leaf spots
Dark brown spots on seed glumes and panicle branches

differential_diagnoses.distinguishing_factor: Blast lesions are typically spindle-shaped with pointed ends, whereas Brown Spot produces rounded/oval lesions.
Narrow brown spot causes linear, narrow streaks parallel to leaf veins, not oval spots.
